inspiration.observed_pattern: A correlated JSON_TABLE call converts each comma-separated string column into ordered relational rows by constructing a JSON array with CONCAT and REPLACE.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reauthored as a fixed product-label report. Each product's comma-separated labels become a JSON array expression, JSON_TABLE emits ordinal and label columns, and deterministic product/ordinal ordering preserves source order; recursive and helper-table alternatives are omitted.

fixture_notes: Three fixed products expose two, one, and three labels; the ordinal column preserves each source string's label order.
determinism_notes: Product IDs, comma-separated labels, JSON construction, ordinals, and final ordering are fixed; no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE product_labels (product_id INT PRIMARY KEY, product_name VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, label_csv VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL)

steps.sql: SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, jt.ordinal_no, jt.label FROM product_labels AS p, JSON_TABLE(CONCAT('[\"', REPLACE(p.label_csv, ',', '\",\"'), '\"]'), '$[*]' COLUMNS (ordinal_no FOR ORDINALITY, label VARCHAR(32) PATH '$')) AS jt ORDER BY p.product_id, jt.ordinal_no
